column3: vajraṃ ca mauktikaṃ śvetaṃ māṇikyaṃ lohitaṃ viduḥ |
nīlaṃ nīlaṃ samākhyātaṃ marakataṃ haritaṃ hitam ||
śvetaṃ pītaṃ ca gomedaṃ puṣyarāgaṃ ca piñjaram |
kośale ca kaliṅge ca magadhe ca himālaye |
ratnānām uttamaṃ vajraṃ yo bibharti narottamaḥ |
uttamaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ yathā śakras tathaiva saḥ ||
abhedyaṃ ca tathādāhyam aśoṣyākledyam eva ca |
yathaivātmā tathā vajraṃ tasmān maulyaṃ samarpayet ||
malaṃ bindur yavo rekhā veṣagyam kākapādavat |
tuṅgaṃ vajraṃ praśaṃsanti ṣaṭkoṇaṃ laghu bhāskaram |
dūrāt tasya praṇaśyanti vajraṃ yasya gṛhe bhavet ||
pañcāśad bhavati maulyaṃ ratnaśāstre hy udāhṛtam ||
piṇḍato dviguṇasthaulyaṃ taulyaṃ caiva yadā bhavet |
caturguṇaṃ bhaven mūlyaṃ triguṇe tv aṣṭamaṃ yathā ||
śveto raktas tathā pītaḥ kṛṣṇaś ca kuliśo bhavet |
column5: śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā jvālāmukhī bhavet |

column3: uttamaṃ brāhmaṇe maulyaṃ madhyamaṃ kṣatriye tathā |
yan maulyaṃ brāhmaṇe proktam pādonaṃ kṣatriye smṛtam |
vajram ca trividhaṃ proktaṃ naro narī napuṃsakam |
tad eva cet pītākāraṃ strīvajraṃ vartulāya ca ||
tyajyaṃ syān naiva phaladaṃ puṃvajreṇa vinā kvacit |
kṛtrimatvaṃ yathā vajre kathyate sūribhiḥ kvacit |
kṣārāmlair lepayed vajraṃ gharme ca pariśodhayet |
gurviṇībhir na dhartavyo yuvatībhir ayam maṇiḥ |
hariśvetaṃ tathā vaṃśe pītaśvetaṃ ca śūkare ||
rāgas trāsaś ca binduś ca rekhā ca jalagarbhatā |
sarvaratneṣv amī pañca doṣāḥ sādhāraṇā matāḥ |
kṣetratoyabhavā doṣā ratneṣu na laganti te ||
column5: kṣetratoyabhavā doṣā ratneṣu na laganti te ||

khyātam toyaprabhaṃ vṛttaṃ mauktikaṃ navadhā śubham ||

column3: sacchidraṃ karkaśaṃ kṣaudraṃ raktābhaṃ ca sabindukam |
malinaṃ niṣprabhaṃ citraṃ bhagnam tu mauktikaṃ tyajet ||
svacchābhaṃ ca suvṛttaṃ ca guru snigdhaṃ ca nirmalam |
pītacchāyo bhaved vaiśyaḥ śūdrarucir bhavet [... au3 Zeichenjh] ||
prāpnoty eva sajātiḥ syād gṛhe nirdoṣaśaṅkhajam ||
suvṛttaṃ suprabhaṃ śvetaṃ guñjāmātram anardhi ca |
yathā ca vardhate muktā tathā maulyaṃ ca vardhate |
kṣīyate ca yathā muktā tathā maulyaṃ hi hīyate ||
guñjānāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā bhāreṇa ca mitaṃ ca tat |
